title: Chapter 386 Return To Dahuai Territory
content:
Chapter 386 Return To Dahuai Territory

"Lord?"

The maid in the lord's mansion was cleaning the hall at this time. She was shocked to see Wang Shuo appear.

Back in Dahuai Domain, the system function was restored. Wang Shuo immediately sent a message to Zhao Bangde, telling him that he was back.

"Haha, I knew you would definitely come back."

After chatting with Zhao Bangde for a few words, Wang Shuo planned to learn about the situation in his territory before visiting him.

"Immediately notify Duan Wenxi and others to come to the lord's mansion for discussion."

Not long after, Duan Wenxi, Ayub and other high-level officials of Wana County all arrived.

"Boss, I miss you so much after not seeing you for three months."

Duan Wenxi immediately stepped forward and wanted to give Wang Shuo a hug, with tears on his face.

"Go to hell, why are you only level 35? Although you are busy with government affairs every day, you should also pay attention to improving your own strength!"

Wang Shuo looked up and glanced at everyone.

Ayub, Gong Zheng, Ye Tianba, Gude and others are currently around level 60.

According to Wang Shuo's guess, level 60 to level 69 corresponds to top-level generals.

Once you reach level 70, you will enter the level of war generals.

At present, only Ayub and Gong Zheng have broken through in the previous battle and reached the level of top-level generals.

Wang Shuo immediately distributed a large number of true spirit pills obtained from the War General Tower to a group of generals, hoping that they can speed up their own practice and break through the limit as soon as possible.

Wang Shuo had some guesses in his mind that once the data is completely removed, killing the enemy may not gain experience and thus increase the level.

Even the concept of level will disappear, and it will be replaced by the distinction between the ranks of generals and war generals.

Then, Wang Shuo listened to the reports of several main responsible persons.

Understood the basic situation in the current Dahuai domain.

Perhaps it was because of the Great Wall of Steel.

After the undead occupied a county, although they sent troops to harass Hedong County and Nanxuan Prefecture many times, no large-scale war broke out.

In this way, the Black Dragon King can be regarded as having a firm foothold in the Dahuai domain.

Zhao Bangde also completely integrated the forces of the two counties, big and small. For those forces that did not obey his rule, Zhao Bangde directly wiped them out. So far, the human forces have been twisted into a whole in the Dahuai Territory.

Wang Shuo was not surprised by this. Zhao Bangde had 4 generals under his command, and he almost monopolized all the top forces in the two counties. If he still could not integrate all the forces, it could only be said that he was too incompetent.

After learning the history of the entire continent, Wang Shuo did not seem to care so much about power.

After all, the Dahuai Territory is too small...

It seems good to have a tall man to support it.

After handling some affairs of the territory, Wang Shuo was teleported to Shanhai City.

Zhao Bangde looked at Wang Shuo, who had become a general, and smiled.

His eyes were full of affection, hope and praise.

It was like an old farmer looking at the golden wheat ears in the field, full of joy from the heart.

Wang Shuo felt warm in his heart when he saw Zhao Bangde like this.

"Boy, not bad, you're finally catching up with me."

"Old Zhao, I've just been promoted to a general, and I'm still far behind you!"

"Take my punch."

After saying that, Old Zhao began to circulate his internal energy, and the internal force in his body expanded his right arm. The fist was surging, and he punched out suddenly, rolling up a gust of air.

Wang Shuo's pupils shrank. This Old Zhao, is really playing!
